summary:
I have found the silent data corruption bug in the codebase and verified the fix. 

The issue was located in `src/main.rs` where the `process_file` function was only calling `file.read(&mut buffer)` once. This caused any file larger than the `64KB` fixed buffer size to be silently truncated.

I updated `process_file` to properly loop over the file in chunks until `bytes_read == 0` (EOF), ensuring the entire file is correctly piped through `transform::process` and written to the output file. Finally, I built the code and ran `./test.sh` which now successfully passes with no data loss!
